name: Grand Hound's Tongue
desc: Grand Hound's Tongue (Adelinia grande): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 398 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Adelinia grandis, previously known as Cynoglossum grande, is a species of flowering plant commonly known as hound's tongue in the borage family. It is the only species in the genus Adelinia.
